executor_contract.on_blocked: skip the task, set status=blocked with blocked_by.reason and blocked_by.owner; never substitute a smaller edit that looks like the fix

hard_rules: No cloaking: different content per user-agent is eliminated or explicitly owned and documented; never optimise around it.
Never fabricate statistics, clients, awards, certifications, sameAs URLs or timelines.
Do not break SEO, a11y or users to please bots; an a11y regression is a GEO regression.
Fix causes in templates, never instances on a single page.
Keep bitara.co; the TLD is not the problem, conflation is; never propose a migration.
Every locale is one surface (11 in the sitemap, /ja included) or you have created an inconsistency.
Never remove SpeakableSpecification, the api-catalog/openapi.json/api-docs Link relations, or an existing sameAs without a stated reason.
No MCP servers: browser MCPs measured 11,669 tokens/request; wq probe replaces them at 0.
Do not promise Common Crawl inclusion on a schedule.
A skipped check is a failure, not a pass.
Respect security/scope.yml and --authorized before any wq sec command.
One task = one branch = one commit = one gate re-run.

tasks.title: Restore cache validators and cacheability
evidence: no ETag and no Last-Modified on any sampled variant
cache-control: private, no-cache, no-store, max-age=0, must-revalidate
cf-cache-status: DYNAMIC (not edge-cached)
tasks.why: that directive string is what Next.js emits for a dynamically rendered route; without validators crawlers cannot revalidate cheaply, and with no-store neither the edge nor a crawler may cache anything.
change_options: PREFERRED: make public marketing routes cacheable (export const revalidate = <seconds>, or remove the cookies()/headers()/searchParams access that forces dynamic rendering); static output then gets ETag from the host.

ALTERNATIVE: keep it dynamic but cache at the edge - Cache-Control: public, max-age=0, s-maxage=600, stale-while-revalidate=86400 for PUBLIC routes only, letting Cloudflare generate/serve an ETag once the response is cacheable.

assertions: ETag and/or Last-Modified present
a max-age or s-maxage value is set
no blanket no-store on public routes
cf-cache-status HIT on the second request
headers.spec.ts still green

artifacts: before/after header dumps saved into the run directory
forbidden: changing cache-control for personalised, authenticated or preview routes
setting a long max-age on HTML (use s-maxage plus stale-while-revalidate)
